note: Off-by-one: range(n) stops before n. The main demo submission.
code:
n = int(input())
total = 0
for i in range(n):
    total += i
print(total)

note: range(n, 0) has no negative step, so it counts nothing.
code:
n = int(input())
for i in range(n, 0):
    print(i)
print("Liftoff!")

note: Strings have no reverse method: a runtime error rather than a wrong answer.
